items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: And I got him George Lewis. He was a first climber.

ctx.x: I asked him which came first.

We had some band, too. Most of our jobs called for white people. We said. We was up three years before we could play for one color people. And the first time we played for color people when Joe Oliver left from the air. You know, the thing I got in there when I was standing right by Joe Oliver with a fellow drumming him, Buddy Sali. Hit him in the eye with a wheel by the hammer. And you know, I thought Joe would be one eye, you know. And he used to have a man, Carol, all them boys. He must have been around about…
I asked you who this Bourne was. That's not Harrison Bourne.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: George Lewis? Oh, he was good when he was with me and Kid Allen.

ctx.x: Oh, well, some of them are like, uh, Brian Freddie, and, uh, Johnny Dot, and, uh, Jimmy Loon. You remember Jimmy Loon? And he's dead, too, isn't he? Yeah. And, uh, let me see, uh, and Jeff, and, uh, Big Eye Louie, and Johnny Handy. And, uh, he sure has, and, uh, Big Eye Louie, and, uh, and Johnny Handy. And, uh, then they had a whole lot of youngsters, you know, they come up with the jazz, too, you know. Yeah. I can't remember the name of it. Ask him when George Lewis began to get good. When did George Lewis…
George Lewis? Oh, he was good when he was with me and Kid Allen.

Yeah. And we used to play with some band before me and George. Oh, with Oral Lumpus band. We played. Then we left Oral Lumpus band. We played. Then we left Oral Lumpus band. We played. Then we left Oral Lumpus band. We was good then. And we tried to get him to go on site. He tried once, but he didn't like it until he got back on Clionette. Then Clionette come back, but she didn't have nothing to do with that. What's that name? Emile or something? Yeah. Millie Bond. Millie Bond. Millie Bond.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: I knew George Lewis from over in Madisonville.

ctx.x: He had pills and he had George Lewis and he had Mealy Barnes. Ask him was it pills or Mealy Barnes or George Lewis or who?

He said was it pills or Mealy Barnes or George Lewis on clarinet? Who? No, I didn't know George. He wasn't there until George Lewis. I knew George Lewis from over in Madisonville. He wasn't there in the city. He was there in the city. Peel? I said... I think Zed. Zed. Zed, yeah. Zed was there. Yeah. Zed was there. Yeah. Zed was there. Yeah. More refreshing memories.
Did he want some? Ask him if he wants some. You want some? Yeah, I'll make water. I'll get that.
